coverage_notes: Sayari holds no Rwandan customs data. Every row is a third-country record: Tanzania Imports & Exports (Jan 2023-present, which captures Rwandan cargo transiting Dar es Salaam/Rusumo) supplies about 95% of rows (1,823 of 1,923); Vietnam (2020 tungsten, 2020 coltan, 2023-25 tungsten imports), Kazakhstan, Japan, Malaysia (Jan 2025-Feb 2026), UK and Turkey import records supply the rest. Kenya data is imports only (Jan 2024-), so exports via Mombasa are missing. There is no source for 2021-2022 (zero rows is a gap, not zero trade), and Tanzania returns essentially nothing for Jan-Aug 2024 (1 row in 8 months, all three ores), which covers the 30 Apr 2024 Rubaya capture. 2023 H1 is thin (source ramp-up); 2026 runs only to 31 Jul. Air freight (gold) is not covered. Weight is gross declared kg; value exists for only about 15% of rows (mostly 2024), so annual value is null. Rows are customs lines, not consignments: 24 coltan, 48 tin and 31 tungsten rows repeat another row's shipper, buyer, date and weight (multi-container lots or duplicates), and nothing was deduplicated. Party names are noisy (e.g. three Sayari IDs for East Group Minerals, two for African Panther, five for Rani Mining); GW exporters were grouped by name pattern. Sunrise, Philbert, Space and Rani matches are low confidence. Coverage is probably well below half of Rwanda's real 3T exports in most years, and it changes over time, so year-on-year changes in Sayari row counts can reflect coverage rather than trade. Cross-check against Comtrade mirror data and RMB figures before using any volume in the gap indicator. Rule 10 applies throughout: these rows show who shipped what to whom from Rwanda, not where the ore was mined.

destinations_note: basis=arrival_country is the customs arrival field. basis=buyer_domicile_by_name classifies the consignee by name: ARE = Halcyon Inc (Dubai JLT), Minterra/Miterra FZC, Novacore/Novascore FZE, Saiko General Trading LLC-FZ and other FZC/FZE/DMCC names; HKG = East Rise, Hong Kong Minetraco variants, Specialty Metals Resources Ltd (HK), Halo Moon, Haipu; CHN = Chinese-named companies; LUX = Traxys. UAE-domiciled buyers mostly route cargo to China (arrival CHN), so the arrival-country view understates the UAE role.

The only 3T-chapter (HS 26) row from DRC to Rwanda in Sayari. The consignee is not one of the seven GW exporters.

Of 1,923 HS 261590/260900/261100 rows departing RWA, product_origin is RWA for 1,866; COD for 3 (Tawotin, Philbert and Rutongo, above); others are CHN, SGP, ZMB, BDI, FRO or blank. The field is filled in by the declarant and mostly mirrors the departure country, so a RWA value is not evidence of Rwandan mining.

HS 260900 rows include 23 described as "TANTALITE CONCENTRATES" and 10 as "TUNGSTEN CONCENTRATES"; HS 261590 includes Luna Smelter "TIN SLAG" rows (e.g. 79.4 t to Cambodia, Jul 2026). Counts are by declared HS code and have not been reclassified.
